Four certifications have expired, so those people should recertify. Three people hold current certifications but haven't used Claude in the last 90 days, so they need to use Claude in their work. Any one of these three would bring you to 10 once they're active again.
2. Customer story: Your Mesa Verde Credit Union story checks out. The Riverbend Dental Group link currently returns "page not found". Please restore it or send us a working public link. It must not need a login, and it must name both Driftwood Ops and Claude. This is optional for Select, since one working story is enough, but it's worth fixing.

Your three joint customers are confirmed, which meets the Select requirement.

The next promotion date is 2027-01-01. Once the items above are done, we can review you for Select then.

Warm regards,
The Partner Team
